create_ml_backend: create an ML backend for a Label Studio project by sending a POST request to /api/ml
list_ml_backends: list all configured ML backends for a specific project by ID
get_ml_backend_detail: get details of a specific ML backend by its primary key
train_ml_backend: train an ML backend model for a project by its primary key
test_ml_backend_predict: test predictions from an ML backend for a project by its primary key
